statements.quote: We anticipate making capital expenditures of approximately $60 billion to $65 billion in 2025 to support our core business and generative AI efforts.
statements.notes: Total capex guidance; generative AI is named as one driver alongside the core business. This is not an AI-specific amount.

statements.quote: These efforts include significant investments in AI initiatives, including to recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products using generative AI.
statements.notes: The prior sentence ties these efforts to FoA expenses (headcount, data centers, technical infrastructure), so this is read as opex. The sentence is present tense with no year named, so it is treated as an actual for the reported year.

statements.quote: In particular, we expect our AI initiatives will require increased investment in infrastructure and headcount.
statements.notes: Headcount and infrastructure costs are opex. No year is named.
